featured_reviews.name: Khushi
featured_reviews.review_text:
I visited Mandala Pot during its very first week of opening. I initially wanted to try their sushi, but two customers seated nearby mentioned they didn’t enjoy it much, so I decided to skip that and explore other dishes instead.

Despite it being a weekday, the service was quite slow. Each dish took around 30 minutes to arrive.

Here’s what I tried:

🥟 Spinach Cottage Cheese Dimsum
This was the highlight of my meal. The flavours were nice, and I genuinely enjoyed it. I would definitely recommend this dish.

🍜 Korean Ramen
The quantity didn’t feel worth the price (₹400). The noodle portion was average, and the broth tasted more tomato-based than what you’d typically expect from Korean ramen. It was an okay dish, but not something I would reorder.

🍚 Lemon Chilli Rice
Unfortunately, this was the most disappointing dish of the evening. It felt quite bland — almost like plain steamed rice with a few vegetables. I had to squeeze the garnish lemon and ask for chilli oil to enhance the flavour. After such a long wait, this was underwhelming.

I also noticed a few customers cancelling their orders due to the slow service. We wanted to try the crispy honey noodles for dessert, but after hearing feedback from another table that it wasn’t very crispy and was overly sweet, we decided to skip it.

💸 Total bill: ₹910

Overall, it was an underwhelming experience mainly due to the slow service and inconsistent flavours. The dimsum stood out, but the other dishes didn’t quite meet expectations. Hoping they improve with time as they’re newly opened.

featured_reviews.name: Alpesh Vadatkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had an extremely horrible and unsafe experience at this restaurant.

My friend and I visited to have Chinese food, and after finishing our meal, he suddenly had a swallowing issue and urgently tried to drink water from the bottle kept on the table. Unfortunately, in that moment of panic, he didn’t realize that the bottle placed there was not water—but vinegar.

This is absolutely unacceptable. Who in their right mind keeps a vinegar bottle on the table in a way that looks exactly like a water bottle? This is not just careless—it’s dangerous.

When I questioned the staff about this, instead of apologizing or taking responsibility, they responded with complete arrogance. The staff bluntly said, “You should have read before drinking,” which is a ridiculous thing to say in an emergency situation. There was zero empathy, zero accountability.

To make matters worse, the owner got involved and started arguing aggressively instead of resolving the issue. He kept justifying that they place “sauce bottles” on the table—but that was simply not true. Only the vinegar bottle was kept, and it was misleading enough to cause this situation.

The behavior of both the staff and the owner was extremely rude, disrespectful, and unprofessional. Not only do they lack basic customer service skills, but they also show no concern for customer safety.

I would strongly advise everyone to avoid this place. There are far better and safer options nearby. I regret choosing this restaurant just because the neighboring one was crowded.

Absolutely not recommended.

​The Highlights:
​The Chinese Food: Truly top-notch! While I’ve noticed the North Indian dishes have become a bit more "average" lately, the Chinese menu remains consistently excellent.
​Quality & Safety: One of the main reasons I keep coming back is the food quality. In four years, I have never had any digestive issues, which speaks volumes about their hygiene and ingredients.
​Service & Atmosphere: The ambiance is lovely, and the staff's hospitality is always warm and welcoming. Their home delivery service is also very reliable and prompt.
​My Personal Recommendations:
If you are visiting or ordering in, you have to try these:
​Kung Pao Chicken
​Teriyaki Chicken
​Chinese Village Special Rice
​Hakka Noodles
​Burnt Garlic Rice
​Chilli Garlic Noodles
​I highly recommend this place if you are craving authentic, high-quality Chinese food!

featured_reviews.name: Aryann
featured_reviews.review_text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Delightful Experience!

I ordered Veg Singapore Curry Leaf Rice and Veg Fukien Noodles Gravy, and honestly, both dishes turned out to be a pleasant surprise!

The Veg Singapore Curry Leaf Rice came with the rice and gravy packed separately. The rice looked simple—like fried rice without any oil stains or visible veggies—but the grains were perfectly cooked. The orange-colored gravy was rich and homely, with finely chopped vegetables and a mild, comforting flavor. No overpowering masala or spice—just balanced, clean-tasting food that felt like a good home-cooked meal. The portion was generous, easily enough for 2–3 people.

The Veg Fukien Noodles Gravy was equally impressive. The noodles and gravy were packed separately in good-sized containers (around 500ml each). The gravy had a lovely Manchurian-style color, filled with lots of vegetables and a very satisfying, minimal yet tasty flavor. Again, not too spicy, not too oily—just perfect for someone who enjoys simple, well-made food.

It was my first time ordering from this restaurant and I’m genuinely happy with the experience. Great quantity, neat packaging, and most importantly, food that feels fresh and comforting. Definitely ordering again! 🍜🍛
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Thank you so much for your review and rating. Much appreciated 🙏 your feedback are our strength.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Chows Yummy Food Point in Queens Park, Miraroad, is a must-visit for anyone craving delicious Chinese cuisine! The variety on the menu is impressive, and every dish I tried was bursting with flavor. The fried rice and Manchurian were standout choices, but the soup was a highlight—absolutely fantastic and full of rich taste.

The cozy ambiance makes it a great spot to unwind, and the friendly, attentive staff enhance the overall experience. I was pleased with the quick service, which allowed us to enjoy our meal without delays.

If you’re looking for a place to enjoy authentic Chinese food, I highly recommend Chows Yummy Food Point.
